## Contracts

An interface declares behavior without state. A class `implements` one or many interfaces — Java's answer to multiple inheritance.

## Default and static methods

Interfaces can carry `default` method bodies (added in Java 8) and `static` helpers. Use defaults to evolve APIs without breaking implementers.

## Functional interfaces

An interface with a single abstract method (SAM) can be implemented with a lambda. `@FunctionalInterface` documents that intent.
